# Lucy

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old (v04)  <sub>[v4 c36 P4](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0004)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 c1 P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 c8 P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

Lucy is fair-haired with long, sleek, neat curls and gentle, mild hazel eyes. She has a straight nose and her mouth is typically set in a "prunes and prisms" expression. She is known to be chubby as a child and possesses a mature grace as she grows up.

_Sources: [v2 c8 P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 c24 P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v4 c4 P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)_

## Personality

Lucy is well-behaved, quiet, submissive, and remarkably calm, rarely getting upset even in frightening or chaotic situations. She is very practical, tidy, dependable, and hard-working, taking pride in being neat and doing small chores carefully. However, she is easily frightened by things like dark rooms, ghosts, or cows, and tends to follow rules and lessons like a small automaton without much imagination. Though prim and unvarying, she is deeply proper, moral, and attentive to etiquette.

_Sources: [v2 c7 P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 c8 P8](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0008), [v2 c8 P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 c8 P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 c10 P14](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0014), [v2 c14 P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 c16 P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 c21 P2](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0002), [v2 c21 P3](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0003), [v2 c24 P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 c24 P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 c26 P33](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0033), [v2 c27 P12](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0012), [v3 c3 P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001), [v3 c13 P10](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0010), [v3 c13 P28](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0028), [v3 c13 P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037)_

## History

Following the death of her mother, Lucy and her twin brother Robin were brought by Thirza to live at Grey Shutters under her and Nell's care. From an early age, Lucy proved to be extremely polite and well-mannered, though she was frequently subject to her brother Robin's antics, such as having her hair pulled or being tricked into standing in a pigpen and getting drenched. When Robin locked her in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse, she wept with fear until Nell rescued her. At seven years old, she began attending school alongside Robin, where she enjoyed her studies but was frightened of dark spaces after hearing ghost stories from a classmate. When a sudden, violent hail storm struck Grey Shutters, Lucy remained remarkably composed while sitting beside Nell. As she grew older, she inherited Nell's former porch room when Nell married, showing great responsibility in helping care for young children during the wedding. By seventeen years of age, she began receiving romantic attention from Ralph Pullen.

## Quotes

> Robin forced me to balance on the pigpen fence. I refused at first, but he taunted me by calling me a fraid-cat.
